title: Coefficient local computation work
statement: Let the output dimension be a positive integer $n$, let the requested bias be a positive rational number at most $1/2$, and let the integral Fourier $1$-norm bound be an integer at least $1$. Define the coefficient local computation work to be the work of the small-bias Fourier estimator, using its sample count and the full set of $n$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: Positive rational bias encoded by a positive numerator and denominator
Encoded bias at most one half
caveat: The estimator’s sample count and work function are referenced but not defined in the supplied statement.
